base_member_text: [L651-L652] (HIGH/manpage-integrity) The `nf90_get_att` declaration contains malformed roff (`\` followed by `fIvalues`) and does not render a valid argument markup.

[L720-L739] (MED/manpage-integrity) The `nf90_rename_att` entry has an unterminated `(Corresponds to ...)` roff construct and lacks a visible closing `.RE` before the next `.HP` entry, so formatting and section boundaries are broken.
audit_member_text: [L651-L652,L722-L741] (LOW/roff-formatting) The get_att synopsis splits its font escape incorrectly, and the rename_att section leaves its RS indentation unclosed before the next routine.

base_member_text: [L59-L68,L88-L92] (MED/api-documentation) The `nf90_create` synopsis omits the optional `initialsize` and `chunksize` arguments that are described immediately below, leaving the callable interface inconsistent within the same entry.
audit_member_text: [L59-L66] (LOW/incomplete-signature) The nf90_create synopsis omits initialsize and chunksize although both appear in its argument declarations, leaving their positional order unspecified.

base_member_text: [L485-L490] (HIGH/manpage-integrity) The `nf90_rename_var` prototype contains malformed roff/text (`intent9in)` and parameter `name` versus `newname`), so generated documentation cannot be trusted for this routine's signature.
audit_member_text: [L485-L489] (LOW/invalid-signature) The nf90_rename_var declaration contains invalid intent9in) syntax and declares newname where the synopsis uses name.

base_member_text: [L1-L3,L18-L21,L967-L1009] (MED/provenance) This is a 2000 netCDF version-3 man page containing legacy CRAY/UNICOS and Majordomo instructions, with no indication of the bundled library version or whether the documented interface matches the linked NetCDF-Fortran installation.

[L500-L509,L540-L549] (MED/api-documentation) The `nf90_put_var` and `nf90_get_var` prototypes use the literal placeholder `<<whatever>>` for the polymorphic data argument, providing no compilable or type-resolution-level interface.

[L623-L630] (MED/api-documentation) The `nf90_put_att` prototype likewise uses `<<whatever>>`, while the prose lists supported kinds without documenting how the generic Fortran interface dispatches them.

[L37-L45,L514-L528,L554-L569] (MED/error-contract) Although status-returning functions are introduced, the routine descriptions do not consistently state which invalid states/arguments produce errors or whether output arguments are defined after a nonzero status.

audit_member_text: [L91,L239,L822] (LOW/api-reference-inconsistency) References to nf__open, nf__enddef, and nf90_varinq do not match the corresponding Fortran-90 routines documented in this manual.
[L413-L420,L434-L441] (LOW/incomplete-signature) The nf90_def_var declarations omit the varid output and show only an array dimids declaration despite explicitly supporting a scalar dimids argument.
[L465-L479] (MED/incorrect-output-contract) The nf90_inquire_variable explanation treats scalar ndims as an array containing dimension IDs and applies SIZE to it, conflating ndims with dimids.

[L500-L508,L540-L548] (MED/incomplete-transfer-contract) The variable read/write signatures jump directly from start to stride and provide no count argument or explanation of how transfer extents are selected, making positional use and partial-array transfers ambiguous.
[L593] (LOW/incorrect-output-contract) The attribute inquiry describes xtype as the variable's external type although the queried object is an attribute whose type can differ.

[L782-L785,L434-L440] (LOW/dimension-contract-inconsistency) The common dimids description permits a vector larger than the variable rank without distinguishing inquiry output capacity from definition input, whereas nf90_def_var says every supplied element contributes a dimension.

[L878-L883] (MED/fill-mode-contract) The manual recommends OR-ing nf90_nofill into open/create mode despite omitting it from both routines' flag lists, leaving that alternative to nf90_set_fill unsupported by the documented creation/opening contracts.
